raw:

  relation "prescribe"
  role subject "the doctor from the clinic"
  role object "the user"
  role topic "syrup three times a day"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "want"
  role subject "the child"
  role object "the syrup"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "mix"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "the syrup"
    role instrument "tea"
    polarity affirmed
  end
